fields.Name: User Impersonation Started
fields.Description: An authorized user started a temporary impersonation session viewing the system as another user. Details JSON captures actorUserId, actorEmail, targetUserId, targetEmail, apiKeyId, and expiresAt.

fields.Name: User Impersonation Ended
fields.Description: A temporary user impersonation session ended and its scoped API key was revoked and cleaned up. Details JSON captures actorUserId, targetUserId, and apiKeyId.

fields.Name: User Impersonation Denied
fields.Description: A user impersonation request was denied by server-side authorization or anti-escalation checks (missing authorization grant, nested impersonation attempt, or forbidden target user).
